summary: Learn to run focused meetings, capture decisions, and track actions with practical facilitation tools. Enrol today.
lede: Meeting management and decision facilitation helps professionals plan and run meetings that produce clear decisions, recorded actions, and follow-up. Designed for people who plan, facilitate, document, or influence decision-making meetings, it covers setting objectives and timed agendas, framing decisions and testing agreement, handling disruption, and documenting minutes, owners, deadlines, and next steps; it also introduces virtual meeting controls and AI-assisted transcription review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, facilitate, document, or influence meetings where decisions must be made and actions tracked.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience attending or coordinating meetings in an office, project, operations, or administrative environment. Familiarity with meeting minutes, calendars, shared documents, and basic workplace communication is helpful. No coding is required. If you support leadership meetings, project meetings, committee meetings, or virtual meetings, you are prepared for the hands-on exercises.
